pins.name: D4
pins.label: GPIO4 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL - onboard single status NeoPixel (WS2812), output-only data line, distinct from the external-strip terminal on GPIO21. Confirmed via learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-rp2040-prop-maker-feather/pinouts ("connected to GPIO4 ... In CircuitPython, the LED is used to indicate the runtime status"), CircuitPython pins.c (NEOPIXEL -> pin_GPIO4), and Zephyr's adafruit_feather_propmaker_rp2040.dts onboard_ws2812 node (gpios = <&gpio0 4 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>).

pins.name: D7
pins.label: GPIO7 (Button)
pins.notes: PIN_BUTTON / BOOT - onboard bootloader-select pushbutton, also usable as a general input when application code is running. Active-low with the RP2040's internal pull-up enabled. Confirmed via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_propmaker_rp2040.dts onboard_button node (gpios = <&gpio0 7 (GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW | GPIO_PULL_UP)>) and Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("To enter the bootloader, press and hold Boot and then power up the board"; board.BUTTON in CircuitPython). Full digital_input/digital_output/pwm_output retained, matching the adafruit_feather_scorpio GPIO7 / pimoroni_plasma2040 GPIO23 BOOT-button precedents.

pins.name: D13
pins.label: GPIO13 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED - onboard status LED above the USB-C connector, active-high. Confirmed via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_propmaker_rp2040.dts red_led node (gpios = <&gpio0 13 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>), consistent with Adafruit's own pinouts guide (board.LED / PIN_LED). digital_input dropped to match this repo's established led_high precedent (rpipico, adafruit_feather_scorpio); pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2040 GPIO. This GPIO was also the vendor's default (unused) PIN_SPI0_SS alias, which would have contaminated this confirmed LED tag with a spurious spi_ss capability - fixed 2026-07-13 by removing that alias from pins_arduino.h (no onboard SPI device consumes it - the audio amp uses I2S, the accelerometer uses I2C), matching the adafruit_feather_scorpio precedent for this exact bug class.

pins.name: GPIO19
pins.label: GPIO19
pins.notes:
PIN_EXTERNAL_BUTTON - spare general-purpose GPIO routed to the "Btn" screw-terminal/pad for the user's OWN external button or LED, not hardware on this board's own PCB. Confirmed explicitly bidirectional via learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-rp2040-prop-maker-feather/pinouts: "Extra digital input or output pin. It can be used for button input or digital output, for activation or a simple LED." No button/led tag applied (reserved for the board's own onboard hardware, not a user-wired external component). No static-const alias exists for this GPIO in this board's bespoke pins_arduino.h; this entry restores general-purpose availability.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO20
pins.label: GPIO20
pins.notes:
PIN_EXTERNAL_SERVO - bare RP2040 GPIO routed to the servo header's "Sig" pin. Adafruit's guide labels it "Servo motor output pin" (use-case framing) but documents no hardware restricting its direction (only the servo's separate V+ power rail is switched, via GPIO23) - matching this repo's pimoroni_plasma2040 GPIO14 (CLK) precedent, where a similarly use-case-labeled pin was still confirmed general-purpose. No static-const alias exists for this GPIO in this board's bespoke pins_arduino.h; this entry restores general-purpose availability.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO21
pins.label: GPIO21
pins.notes:
PIN_EXTERNAL_NEOPIXELS - the external NeoPixel-strip data-output terminal ("Neo"), distinct from this board's own onboard status NeoPixel on GPIO4. Adafruit's guide labels it "The external NeoPixel data output pin" but this board's own pinouts page was checked explicitly for level-shifter wording and none was found (unlike the separate standalone "Prop-Maker FeatherWing" companion product, whose own guide does describe one - that inference does not carry over here without direct confirmation). Matching this repo's adafruit_feather_scorpio (GPIO16-23) and pimoroni_plasma2040 (GPIO15/DAT) precedents, an external-strip-driver terminal with no confirmed direction-restricting hardware is left general-purpose. No led_neopixel tag applied - per this repo's pimoroni_plasma2040 policy, that tag is reserved for a board's own onboard addressable LED, not an external-strip terminal. No static-const alias exists for this GPIO in this board's bespoke pins_arduino.h; this entry restores general-purpose availability.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO22
pins.label: GPIO22
pins.notes:
PIN_ACCELEROMETER_INTERRUPT - dedicated interrupt line from the onboard LIS3DH accelerometer (I2C address 0x18, on the shared STEMMA QT bus), not general purpose. Confirmed via learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-rp2040-prop-maker-feather/pinouts ("interrupt pin is connected to GPIO22 ... Part of LIS3DH accelerometer") and CircuitPython pins.c (ACCELEROMETER_INTERRUPT -> pin_GPIO22).
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO23
pins.label: GPIO23
pins.notes:
PIN_EXTERNAL_POWER - dedicated control line for the onboard transistor that switches the 5V rail feeding the Neo/Sig terminal blocks, servo header, and I2S amplifier; not general purpose. Confirmed via learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-rp2040-prop-maker-feather/pinouts ("connected to a separate control transistor for the 5V terminal block pin, servo header and the I2S amplifier ... disabled by default") and independently via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_propmaker_rp2040.dts servo-power-enable gpio-hog node.
